sources.basis: Recorded endDate inclusively within explicit from/to dates, all recorded statuses. Status/start/evaluation/decision dates shown. No automatic upcoming cutoff or official confirmation.

Current explicit assignment rows whose last saved timestamp falls in selected UTC dates. Current department/category and retained assignment label shown. Not historical as-of structure, department headcount, workforce population, or all events in range.
Recorded evaluation interval overlaps date range; answered/total form questions and feedback entries. No rating/outcome aggregates.
Recorded training interval overlaps range; unique attended dates per record inside dates. No cross-course credit/pass/certification.
Manually reported lastWorkingDate in range. Global undated cases shown separately. Not actual exits/turnover.
Assignment created in UTC range; current explicit read/ack timestamps for exact revision. No legal acknowledgement conclusion.

Current task rows with dueDate inclusively in explicit selected dates, across all statuses. Current submission/approval metadata; not historical-as-of pending, overdue or all-task totals. Global undated count explicitly separate.

Retained submit/approve events created inside selected UTC dates. Original actor name, before/after status, task title and version retained; one event per row, not unique task count or current approval queue. Account/context resolves from assignee retained in event; names/context from current directory disclosed separately. No private note/reason/hash/payload.

Current retained draft metadata with explicit documentDate inclusively in selected dates. Original template ID/version retained despite later template edit. Draft only; no issued/signed/delivered/pending-contract status or document content included.

unresolved.dependency: Authorized workforce population, employment episodes, lifecycle/status/joining definitions required.
Actual employment exits and denominator/date/population rules required; manual offboarding is not turnover.

Existing raw attendance/export/explicit leave/salary history remain bounded. Work calendars, working-day/paid/payroll/currency/tax/approval definitions and reconciled sources required for derived totals.

context: Current organization context at report generation for every row, never backcast to source dates. Missing assignment/department/category/evaluation-date counts describe only latest fetched page; row count disclosed. Not recorded remains explicit. Task decision context uses the assignee ID retained in that event; current account/organization names never overwrite recorded actor/title/status facts. Fresh per-request snapshots may change across later pages; not an immutable export.
scope: Nine retained source projections only; independent QA pending. No workforce/lifecycle/financial/issued-document totals inferred. No permission grant changes.
